Name: Stardew Hetalia
Author: WillowArcticae
Description:
This mod replaces ALL NPC's including the less prominent such as Marlon, Gunther, The henchman... As well as some Hetalia related easter eggs ;).  Gunther is replaced with Slovenia, the only character I personally created and is not cannon.
There may be some things I missed in dialogue, so please do not hesitate to inform me about them.
I have not touched NPC's gift tastes, but did my best to change the dialogue to reflect the mod.
